maya: quick debrief from the GPTQ bake we ran this morning across Llama/Mistral/Qwen families. TL;DR: mostly promising but a few spot regressions to triage. :eyes:

arjun: great — summary numbers?

maya: high-level numbers:
- MMLU (instruction subset): Llama-2-70B GPTQ-8 -> -0.9% absolute, AWQ-8 -> -0.4%
- Mistral-7B GPTQ-8 -> -1.6% (we think kv drift at long context)
- Qwen-7B GPTQ-8 -> +0.1% (noisy)
- LAMBADA: Llama GPTQ-8 -1.2%, AWQ-8 -0.6%
- HellaSwag: Mistral GPTQ-8 -2.3% but FP8 baseline also low (possible eval sensitivity)

kevin: oof Mistral HellaSwag -2.3% is notable. Was that across random seeds or single export?

maya: single-run for that family. We ran a small 3-seed spotcheck for Llama and Qwen — variance ~0.2-0.4% on MMLU. For Mistral we only had 1 seed before infra throttled.

sam: any qualitative failure modes? hallucination uptick, instruction adherence?

maya: yes — on instruction-following eval the Mistral GPTQ runs produced shorter completions and occasional truncation near long generated sequences. KV cache mismatch suspected: conversation-style prompts with >2k context showed token dropoff.

lia: did we test the new per-channel scale hack (pcq) we prototyped?

maya: not on Mistral yet. We tried pcq on Llama and saw LAMBADA improve ~0.5% vs plain GPTQ.

arjun: thanks. What about deployment profiles / inference latency and memory?

maya: rough numbers on GA100-type nodes (batch=1, seq=1024):
- Llama-2-70B GPTQ-8: peak mem down ~38% vs FP16, latency ~+5% tokens (decode time)
- Mistral-7B GPTQ-8: mem down ~45%, latency ~+2%
- Qwen-7B GPTQ-8: mem down ~42%, latency ~+3%
AWQ had slightly higher CPU postprocessing overhead (dequant step) which increased 95th pct latency by ~8ms.

kevin: good to know. Any ops caveats for rollout?

maya: callouts:
- KV-anchoring: Mistral needs KV-alignment check. Add a small streaming-check unit test (see snippet).
- Tokenizer differences: Qwen tokenization led to a few edge-case eval mismatches — added normalizer filter in the eval harness.
- Calibration: per-layer act scale calibration for GPTQ reduced variance on Llama.

bakebot: new artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-bake/3519876543/results.tar.gz (contains logs, eval csv, conversion scripts) :thumbsup:

sam: can you paste the conversion commands you ran? want to reproduce locally.

maya: sure — conversion we used for GPTQ (condensed):
```
python convert_gptq.py \
  --model-dir ./checkpoints/llama-70b \
  --out-dir ./quant/llama-70b-gptq8 \
  --bits 8 \
  --per-channel True \
  --calib-samples 2048
```
And run eval harness: `python eval_harness.py --models ./quant/* --suites mmlu,hellaswag,lambada --seed 42`

lia: nice. Next steps?

maya: proposal:
1) Hold Mistral GPTQ-8 from wide rollout until we run 3-seed reproducibility + KV-alignment tests.
2) Promote Llama GPTQ-8 to internal staging for a small canary (10% traffic) with AWQ fallback.
3) Qwen GPTQ-8 ok to include in general quant pool but add tokenizer normalization step.
4) Add automated post-quant smoke: 100 prompts from production promptset + token-level diff check and hallucination heuristic.

arjun: +1 to those. Also add a perf regression gate in the CI to detect 95th pct latency increases >10ms.

kevin: I'll own the canary rollout script and the perf gate. tagging @ops to prep rollout windows.

sam: I'll schedule a follow-up 1-hr triage tomorrow to go over Mistral failure cases — bring logs (maya) and per-layer stats (arjun).

maya: ack. Uploading a short notes doc to the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-QUANT-1347

lia: thanks — appreciated. rough ETA for extra runs?

maya: re-run seeds + pcq + kv-check tonight on preemptible cluster, should have preliminary tomorrow morning (PST).

bakebot: experiment job 64213 finished: summary csv attached to the artifact. :white_check_mark:

arjun: perfect — people added to the ticket for visibility. closing thread for now, will repost results once we have the 3-seed numbers. :rocket:
